title: Managed Git hook text
responsibility: Renders stage-specific hook wrappers that chain existing hooks and run Harness only in opted-in worktrees.

inputs.name: stageFile.stage
inputs.description: Hook stage; pre-push retains the original opt-in filename, other names receive a suffix.

inputs.name: hookScript.stage
inputs.description: Stage to render, normally pre-push or commit-msg. Only commit-msg uses the no-stdin message-file handoff.

inputs.name: managedHook.text
inputs.description: Hook file text to search for the Harness marker.

outputs.name: chainedSuffix
outputs.description: Suffix .harness-chained used to retain an existing hook beside the wrapper.

outputs.name: stageFile
outputs.description: harness-hooks for pre-push; otherwise harness-hooks- followed by the stage.

outputs.name: hookScript
outputs.description: Shell script text that runs an executable chained hook first, preserves its failure, then reads the stage-specific worktree opt-in command and invokes Harness. Producing text does not install or run the hook.

outputs.name: managedHook
outputs.description: True when the text contains the managed marker anywhere.
